import gc
import weakref
from types import FrameType
from field_view_fixture import field_case, retire

def describe(ref):
    if isinstance(ref, FrameType):
        return ('frame', ref.f_code.co_filename, ref.f_code.co_name, ref.f_lineno)
    if isinstance(ref, dict):
        return ('dict', [str(k) for k in ref.keys()][:15])
    return (str(type(ref)), len(ref) if hasattr(ref, '__len__') else None)

def inspect_refs(obj):
    refs0=gc.get_referrers(obj)
    mapping=next(x for x in refs0 if isinstance(x,dict))
    proxy=next(x for x in gc.get_referrers(mapping) if type(x).__name__=='mappingproxy')
    container=next(x for x in gc.get_referrers(proxy) if type(x).__name__=='GpuFieldData')
    frame=next(x for x in gc.get_referrers(container) if isinstance(x,FrameType))
    print('FRAME_REFS',[(describe(x), repr(x)[:300]) for x in gc.get_referrers(frame)],flush=True)
    print('FRAME_BACK',frame.f_back.f_code.co_name if frame.f_back else None,flush=True)

def test_retention():
    import cupy as cp
    case = field_case(cp, type_id=3, shapes=((6,),), base_shift=1, offset=8)
    stream = cp.cuda.Stream(non_blocking=True)
    with stream:
        output = case.result.on_gpu
    stream.synchronize()
    print('OUTPUT',output.only().get(),flush=True)
    ref=weakref.ref(case.result._views.only())
    retire(case)
    print('AFTER_RETIRE',case.budget.committed(),ref() is None,flush=True)
    if ref() is not None: inspect_refs(ref())
    print('GC', gc.collect(),flush=True)
    print('AFTER_GC',case.budget.committed(),ref() is None,flush=True)
    for i in range(3):
        later=field_case(cp,type_id=3,shapes=((6,),),base_shift=1,offset=8)
        with stream: later_output=later.result.on_gpu
        stream.synchronize()
        later_ref=weakref.ref(later.result._views.only())
        retire(later)
        print('LATER',i,later.budget.committed(),later_ref() is None,'FIRST',case.budget.committed(),flush=True)
    import sys
    print('TRACE',sys.gettrace(),sys.getprofile(),sys.exc_info(),flush=True)
    del output
    print('AFTER_OUTPUT',case.budget.committed(),ref() is None,flush=True)
    cp.cuda.get_current_stream().synchronize()
    print('AFTER_NULL_SYNC',case.budget.committed(),ref() is None,flush=True)
